title: Qualification input identity (Stage 1)
description: The frozen content-addressed identity of everything qualification binds: toolchain, tooling.lock, runner identity, release-gate evidence, and the architecture-review record. Stage 1 excludes the report/receipts/final-manifest which do not yet exist. Owned/implemented by Todo 37. Todo 1 shipped this as a restrictive stub; Todo 37 froze it by adding the two normative facts the Stage-1 identity must carry and the stub had nowhere to put: `producer` (the plan requires the identity to record `producer: produce-qualification` and the producer binary hash, so F1 can reject missing/mismatched producer provenance instead of assuming artifacts appeared implicitly) and `bound_inputs` (the plan requires the identity to bind the plan SHA, Cargo.lock, canonical manifests, addon/archive/fixture/Red-patch hashes, harness/evidence-schema inputs and the review-bindings content hash, none of which the eight stub fields can express). Nothing was removed or relaxed: every stub field stays required and `additionalProperties` stays false.

producer.description: Which binary emitted this document. Exactly the Todo-37-owned producer; never Todo 35's harness, which emits no final artifact.

bound_inputs.description: Every content-addressed input this frozen identity binds, keyed by a stable logical name. The producer enforces the exact required key set and non-emptiness; the schema enforces each entry's shape.
